assay: bulk RNA-seq (Oxford Nanopore PromethION cDNA), rectus femoris of the operated leg (S4.3.p1, S4.4.p2)
subjects: 8 women aged 73-77 after THA; control = standard isometric-exercise (IE) protocol n=4, experimental = additional/longer IEs n=4, sequential non-randomized allocation (S4.1.p2)
repeated_measure_unit: patient (biopsies at d0, d1, d12 from the same patient; S4.3.p1, S4.6.p2)
technical_replicates: up to three sequencing runs per biopsy, all included in the paper's analysis (FIG3 legend)
primary_estimand: Effect of the additional isometric-exercise rehabilitation on the rectus femoris transcriptome: the paper reads it from within-arm 12d-vs-preop changes (exp12vs0 vs ctr12vs0); the exercise-attributable contrast is the arm difference in that change (interaction), which the paper does not test directly
planned_contrasts: 1vs0: d1 vs d0, both arms pooled, paired on patient (S4.6.p2; paper 593 up / 1986 down)
ctr12vs0: control d12 vs d0 (S2.2.1.p3; paper 546 up / 190 down)
exp12vs0: experimental d12 vs d0 (S2.2.1.p3, S3.p7; paper 3989 up / 290 down)
paper_method: featureCounts counts, DESeq2 1.38.3 Wald test, BH FDR <= 0.05 (S4.5.p1, S4.8.p1); design formula and pairing not stated; technical runs included as samples (FIG3)
enrichment: GSEA with GSEApy on MSigDB sets (S4.7.p1)
